paragraphs: Anterix provides private 900 MHz spectrum to utilities so they can run their own wireless networks instead of leaning on commercial carriers. The company frames that as operational control, with the utility owning the communications infrastructure behind essential services. Licensed spectrum is sold together with deployment solutions and ecosystem partners so utilities can get networks running faster.

The deployment accelerators are described as simplifying site access, device onboarding, and connectivity management. Two of them, TowerX and CatalyX, are named on the solutions page. A partner program helps utilities integrate devices, applications, and network components so deployments move faster. That program spans over 150 technology providers, from rugged device manufacturers to software companies, with solutions validated for 900 MHz networks.

Eleven utility customers are deploying its 900 MHz solutions, the company states. It describes itself as the largest holder of licensed 900 MHz spectrum in the United States, counting the contiguous states plus Hawaii, Alaska, and Puerto Rico. The about page also claims over 93% of Texas counties served. The same page traces the founders back to Nextel.

quote.text: Anterix is the market leader in providing mission-critical private 900 MHz spectrum to the utility sector.
